description.en: 'extended from south Aleppo to Akaba and from the Mediterranean Sea to the desert (Mt. Lebanon excluded)'.
description.ar: 'extended from south Aleppo to Akaba and from the Mediterranean Sea to the desert (Mt. Lebanon excluded)' [امتدت من جنوب حلب إلى العقبة ومن البحر المتوسط إلى الصحراء (من دون جبل لبنان)].
description.he: “extended from south Aleppo to Akaba and from the Mediterranean Sea to the desert (Mt. Lebanon excluded)” [השתרע מדרום חלב ועד עקבה ומהים התיכון ועד המדבר (למעט הר הלבנון)].

sources.quote: The new province—called “Syria”—extended from south Aleppo to Akaba and from the Mediterranean Sea to the desert (Mt. Lebanon excluded).

notes.en: In May-July 1872 Acre, Nablus and Jerusalem were briefly detached as a separate 'Province of Jerusalem' (not mapped as its own slice).
notes.ar: في أيار/مايو-تموز/يوليو 1872 فُصلت عكا ونابلس والقدس لفترة وجيزة كـ'ولاية القدس' منفصلة (غير مرسومة كشريحة مستقلة).
notes.he: במאי-יולי 1872 הופרדו עכו, שכם וירושלים לזמן קצר כ'מחוז ירושלים' נפרד (לא ממופה כפרוסה עצמאית).

description.en: As before but without the independent sanjak of Jerusalem.
description.ar: كما سبق لكن من دون سنجق القدس المستقل.
description.he: כמקודם אך ללא סנג׳ק ירושלים העצמאי.

sources.quote: in the summer of 1872, Nedim separated the sanjak of Jerusalem from the jurisdiction of Damascus, under which it had been for centuries, and constituted it as an independent sanjak subject directly to Istanbul.

sources.quote: decided in May 1872 to separate the three sanjaqs of Acre, Nablus, and Jerusalem from the Province of Syria and to form a new province called Quds-i Sherif Vilayeti

description.en: Reduced inland province (vilayet of Syria, also called the vilayet of Damascus) after the creation of the Province of Beirut; Balqa (east of the Jordan) appended to it in 1888. It included the Golan (kaza of Quneitra) and, from the 1890s, the sanjaq of Karak (Ma'an).
description.ar: ولاية داخلية مقلّصة (ولاية سوريا، وتسمى أيضاً ولاية دمشق) بعد إنشاء ولاية بيروت؛ وأُلحق بها البلقاء (شرقي الأردن) سنة 1888. وضمت الجولان (قضاء القنيطرة)، ومنذ تسعينيات القرن التاسع عشر سنجق الكرك (معان).
description.he: פרובינציה פנימית מצומצמת (וילאיית סוריה, הנקרא גם וילאיית דמשק) אחרי הקמת וילאיית ביירות; אל־בלקאא (ממזרח לירדן) צורף אליה ב־1888. היא כללה את הגולן (קזה של קוניטרה) ומשנות ה־90 של המאה ה־19 את סנג'ק כרכ (מען).

sources.locator: section 'Administrative Reorganization after the Enactment of the 1864 Vilayet Law'
sources.quote: Another change was made in March 1888 when the Porte decided to separate the Province of Syria into two provinces: a reduced Province of Syria and a new Province of Beirut.
Balqa (a subdistrict within the Sanjaq of Nablus to the east of the Jordan River) was appended to the Province of Syria.
In 1840 Al-Karak was occupied by Ibrahim Pasha; it was administered by the Ottomans in the 1890s
The eastern half retained the old name and is best referred to as the vilayet of Damascus.
Until this new part was detached in 1888, Jabal Nablus became officially known as the district (mutasarrifiyya) of Jabal Nablus and al-Balqa.
Previous to 1894 this sanjaq was called Ma‘an and had its capital at Ma‘an. In 1894 Salt was added to the sanjaq and the capital was moved to Kerak.
Quneiterah was transferred from the Hauran to this sanjaq between 1901 and 1906.

sources.locator: ch. 7, section 'The End of the Empire and Turkish-Arab Relations'
sources.quote: With the occupation of Damascus and the rest of Syria by the Anglo-Arab forces in October 1918 and the Ottoman surrender at the Mudros cease-fire at the end of that month

notes.en: The Golan belonged to this province: the Admiralty handbook lists the kaza of Quneitra in the vilayet of Damascus (moved from the sanjaq of Hauran to that of Damascus between 1901 and 1906). The Karak/Ma'an sanjaq (capital Ma'an until 1894, then Karak) was also part of this vilayet. The Balqa was detached from the Nablus district in 1888 (Doumani).
notes.ar: كان الجولان تابعاً لهذه الولاية: يدرج دليل الأميرالية قضاء القنيطرة ضمن ولاية دمشق (نُقل من سنجق حوران إلى سنجق دمشق بين 1901 و1906). وكان سنجق الكرك/معان (عاصمته معان حتى 1894، ثم الكرك) جزءاً من هذه الولاية أيضاً. وفُصل البلقاء عن لواء نابلس سنة 1888 (دوماني).
notes.he: הגולן השתייך לפרובינציה זו: המדריך של האדמירליות מונה את קזה של קוניטרה בווילאיית דמשק (הועברה מסנג'ק חוראן לסנג'ק דמשק בין 1901 ל־1906). גם סנג'ק כרכ/מען (בירתו מען עד 1894, ואחר כך כרכ) היה חלק מווילאיית זו. אל־בלקאא הופרד ממחוז שכם ב־1888 (דומאני).
